Array.prototype.map()

JavaScript / Reference

The map() method creates a new array populated with the results of calling a function on every element in the source array.

Syntax

const doubled = numbers.map((number) => number * 2);

Description

The callback receives the element, its index, and the array. The method does not change the original array.

Examples

Use map() when each input produces one corresponding output.
